power:1.how: WCH CH224 datasheet V2.0 (done.land mirror, fetched 2026-10-29): table 4-1 pin 8 VBUS 'needs to be shorted to VHV'; table 8.1.1 VIOHV (PG, VBUS) -0.5..32 V; reference schematic 6.1.1 ties VBUS to VHV. The 3.8 V in sect. 7.1 is in the CH224K-substitution notes and repeats the CFG1 figure: a copy error. Lite runs VBUS at 20 V (37 % under 32 V).

parts:15.how: Same as power:1: CH224 V2.0 table 4-1 and table 8.1.1 rate VBUS to 32 V; sect. 7.1's 3.8 V is a copy error in the CH224K-substitution notes.

power:4.how: CH224 V2.0 reference schematic 6.1.1 is this exact circuit: Rset on CFG1 with an MCU's I2C on CFG2/CFG3. Contingency on both boards: the I2C links are 0R (Lite R2/R3); depopulated, CFG2/CFG3 float on their internal pull-ups, which 6.1.1 names as the plain single-resistor case.

power:6.how: Fail-safe by direction: if PG never asserts or can't sink Q4's ~0.35 mA (2.6 V/10k base + VBUS/220k), PVDD simply stays off (no amp, no damage) and firmware reports it (GPIO4 reads PG, GPIO39 reads PVDD). Firmware also drops PVDD before any renegotiation (firmware-requirements L4). Rework: short Q4's emitter pad to the adjacent GND pour.

power:9.how: With R6 220k + C19 2.2 uF the turn-on peak is 5.8 W for a ~28 ms ramp (sim tb_lite_fw_on_20v_FIX), against the AOS AO4485 single-pulse SOA of about 25 W at 5 ms and 20 W at 10 ms that the power review read (POWER-2/4): >3x margin, so a clone with up to a third less SOA still passes. Steady state 5 A x 15 mohm = 0.38 W.

audio:3.how: R54 100k -> 10k: SDZ sits at 3.2 V - 50 uA x 10k = 2.7 V worst case (TI SLOS708G IIH max 50 uA) against VIH 2.0 V: 0.7 V margin.

digital:22.how: Everest ES8388 datasheet rev 5.0 (July 2018) sect. 5.2: 2-wire chip address 001000x, x = AD0 (the CE pin): 0x10 with CE (pin 26) on GND, as Lite wires it. Fetched 2026-10-29.

thermal:8.how: Margin holds even at hwde's pessimistic 47 C/W: 1.75 W at 1/8 power into 4 ohm gives Tj = 45 + 82 = 127 C, 23 K under the 150 C trip (reviewer's own estimate 94-106 C). Above that, the firmware governor (firmware-requirements L1) and the chip's own latched OTP with FAULTZ recovery (L2) protect it: the failure mode is a mute, not damage. Bring-up measures the case temperature at 1/8 power.

dfm:9.how: Lite J1 HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 (C165948): footprint from EasyEDA (lib_pull 2026-10-29), its VBUS/GND pads redrawn as plain 0.6 x 1.3 mm rectangles (EasyEDA's 0.1 mm stroke left a 0.1 mm VBUS-GND gap) and its signal pads trimmed to 1.13 mm at the tail end (the USB4105's inner edge); shell legs 0.8 mm slots as HRO draws them. CPL: hwde cpl_verify against the LCSC model passes in the dfm gate (2026-10-29), no offset warning.

audio:20.how: TI SLASEE9C (rev. May 2025) section 5 and the pin table: the DDV PowerPAD is on the top side, 'connect to grounded heatsink'; RthJA 44.8 C/W without one (DFM-3, THERMAL-1). The 'pad on bottom' feature bullet contradicts the drawing and pin table. Handled by the lid-pressed heatsink (docs/review-2/dispositions.json THERMAL-1).

parts:23.how: Lead (00:39Z) rejects a hand-fitted heatsink: needs a JLC-fittable board-mount part or a pad-down amp. See docs/review-2/heatsink-options.md: none found that holds 18 C/W.

audio:29.how: Firmware's (C7): the register set is written over I2C after boot and can be changed by OTA; the hardware (I2S at 49.152 MHz MCLK, 1.7 % under the limit) fits ESS's documented modes.

audio:32.how: PCM5102A DIN is a plain high-impedance CMOS input (TI SLAS859 pin table: no internal pull); with its +-10 uA max leakage against the ESP32's ~45k IO12 pull-down at reset, IO12 sits at <=0.45 V, under VIL 0.825 V: the strap reads low (3.3 V flash).

audio:34.how: ES7243E BCLK-as-MCLK (register 0x02 bit 7) is set by firmware (C10). If it didn't work, only the line-in/self-measurement ADC would be lost; streaming to the DAC and amps doesn't use it. Bring-up checks the ADC first thing.

audio:37.how: Parts review (docs/review-2/parts.md, 2026-10-29): every SOT-23 transistor checked datasheet pin -> symbol -> pad; S8050 (C2146) B=1, E=2, C=3 matches.

digital:2.how: R45 is now 2.2k: OE stays under 30 % VDD (0.99 V) against any internal OE pull-up of 5.1k or more (oscillator OE pull-ups are typically ~100k); the TCA9539 that drives it has no pull-up and resets with EN. Bring-up scopes IO0 at EN rise.

thermal:3.how: The heatsink's real RthSA is a purchase-side fact; the board's safety doesn't rest on it: OTW (P11) and FAULT (P10) plus the ISENSE governor bring a hot amp back by turning down, and bring-up checks for no OTW at 1/8 power (C3).

thermal:4.how: Covered by the same OTW/governor backstop (thermal:3); the governor limit (30 W in per chip) holds chip loss to ~3 W whatever the split.

thermal:11.how: Enclosure not yet designed; the Plus/Ultra enclosure task carries the heatsink and vent spec (core README, THERMAL-1); the OTW/governor backstop applies.

thermal:34.how: Lead (00:39Z) rejects a hand-fitted heatsink: needs a JLC-fittable board-mount part or a pad-down amp. See docs/review-2/heatsink-options.md: none found that holds 18 C/W.

dfm:0.how: Pins 1/3 are now 1.6 x 2.4 mm plated slots centred between the two readings of the drawing (0.28 mm to spare at the pin corners either way), legs 2.0 x 3.0 as drawn, on both boards.

dfm:34.how: hwde dfm gate's cpl_verify against each part's LCSC/EasyEDA model passes on both boards after the swaps (2026-10-29): Lite J1 C165948, U6 C81010; core J1 C7095263, U8 C81010, U17 C131972, U18 C42421366, Y1 C7431354.

dfm:16.how: Everlight PLR237/T8BK DPL-0000263 Rev.1 (2021-03-09) p5, fetched from DigiKey 2026-10-30: the side view puts the 1.70 mm locating posts 5.88 behind the port face, the NC pins 2.61 further back and the signal row 2.525 behind those, and the bottom view (port at the top) reads 3-2-1 left to right. On the board U19 (rot 180) has its posts at y 127.28, NC row 129.89 and signal row 132.51, so the port faces the N (rear) edge at y 120.70 and the NC row is nearer the port than the signal row, as drawn.

parts:51.how: Everlight PLR237/T8BK DPL-0000263 Rev.1 (2021-03-09) p5, fetched from DigiKey 2026-10-30: pin 1 Vout, 2 GND, 3 Vcc; bottom view with the port at the top reads 3-2-1 left to right, so seen from above with the port pointing away pin 1 (Vout) is on the left. On the board (port toward the top of a KiCad top view) the left pad, footprint pad 3 at x 137.45, carries /OPT_SPDIF, and the right pad, footprint pad 1 at x 142.53, carries /linein/OPT_VCC. The EasyEDA T10BK footprint numbers pads opposite to Everlight's T8BK but the copper puts Vout and Vcc under the right leads.

parts:52.how: Everlight PLR237/T8BK DPL-0000263 Rev.1 (2021-03-09) p5, fetched from DigiKey 2026-10-30: PCB layout 3 x 0.80 holes at 2.54, 2 x 1.10 NC holes 5.08 apart 2.63 forward, 2 x 1.70 post holes 5.60 apart 2.61 further. The library footprint had the posts but the routed board's U19 never got them (the 1.70 tool in core.drl was only J1's slots): added on 2026-10-30 as NPTH at (137.187, 127.277) and (142.787, 127.277), with the GND stitch via at 137.087/127.197 removed; zones refilled, KiCad DRC 0 violations / 0 unconnected, Gerbers and drill re-exported. Signal 0.914 / NC 1.10 holes take the 0.50 mm square pins. Fit: the T8BK face is 5.88+2.61+2.525 = 11.0 mm ahead of the signal row (11.1 by the layout dims), the box models it at 11.11 (courtyard), so the real face is at most 0.1 mm further back: recess 3.7-3.8 against the 4.0 limit (enclosure/out/ultra/fit.md port_U19), body 9.7 wide, 10.0 tall, port axis 4.35 over the board.

parts:64.how: core J3 and ultra-front J1 are the same part, FPC-05F-20PH20 (C2856803), both at rotation 0 with the mouth on local +y; core.net J3 and ultra-front.net J1 carry the same net on every pin 1-20 (names differ only: FFC_SCK/LCD_SCK, EXP_INT/FRONT_INT_N, IR_IN/IR_OUT, LCD_BL/LCD_BL_PWM). In the Ultra box (enclosure/core_box.py FB_X/FB_BACK/FB_ZB) J1 sits straight in front of J3 at core x 20, mouth down, so the cable runs in one plane and pin N meets pin N. Following the contact face through the cable's three bends (forward off J3, down, forward under the front board, up into J1) turns it from facing J3's board to facing away from J1's board, so the far end needs its contacts on the other side: a type-B (opposite-side) 20-pin 0.5 mm cable, 30-50 mm, as enclosure/README.md says. This holds whether the socket is top- or bottom-contact (the unreadable LCSC PDF), since both ends are the same part.

dfm:7.how: GCT USB4085 drawing rev B (28/02/23) sheet 2 'Recommended PCB Layout, as viewed from component side', fetched from gct.co 2026-10-30: pins at 0.85 pitch, A1..A12 x -2.975..+2.975 and B12..B1 the same; B row 1.35 behind A; front shell slots (2.40/2.10 x 0.90/0.60) 0.98 behind A and 0.37 ahead of B, 8.65 apart; rear slots (1.70/1.40 x 0.90/0.60) 3.38 behind the front slots; rear slot centres 1.74 inside the PCB edge. The board's J1 (USC-C-SMD_USB4085-GF-A) matches to 0.005 mm: A -2.18, B -0.83, front slots -1.20, rear +2.18, x +-4.33, rear slots drilled at x 36.327 = edge 34.587 + 1.74. A1 on the left with the mouth toward the viewer, as GCT. Pin nets match GCT's signal table (A1/A12/B1/B12/shell GND, A4/A9/B4/B9 VBUS_IN, A5 CC1, B5 CC2, A6/B6 D+, A7/B7 D-, A8/B8 open). Pads are 0.70 on 0.40 drills against GCT's 0.65 (DFM-6's choice for annulus; 0.15 mm between pads); order remark asks for hand/selective solder and bridge inspection.

power:26.how: GCT USB4085 drawing rev B (28/02/23) sheet 1 specifications, fetched from gct.co 2026-10-30: 5.00 A collectively for VBUS pins, 6.25 A for GND pins, 48 V DC, 240 W; all 16 contacts and 4 shell legs are through-hole (Dip Type).

digital:30.how: ultra-front is in the repo (boards/ultra-front, README pin table, ultra-front.net): IR_OUT and FRONT_INT_N have 10k pull-ups there, ENC_A/B 10k + 10 nF there, and the front expander is a TCA9535 at 0x27 (clear of 0x10, 0x22/0x23, 0x48, the TCA9539). On Ultra core's own R36/R58/R52/R53 10k and C37/C38 10 nF stay fitted, so each line sees 5k and ENC_A/B 20 nF (same 100 us RC); INT is a wired-OR of two open-drain outputs. Front I2C has no pull-ups (core's).
